sourceText:
White Bean Soup With Greens
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:56am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons olive oil or butter
 cup diced celery
 cup diced carrot
 cup diced onion
1 teaspoon minced garlic
1 can (16 oz.) white navy beans
1 (13 oz.) can clear chicken broth
1/2 cup greens, kale
1/8 teaspoon pepper and salt
2 cans water
8 ounces smoked sausages or ham (diced - 1 ½ c.)

Preparation

1 Oil or butter in medium size saucepan over medium-low heat. Add celery, carrot, green, onion and garlic stir to mix well. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender. Add remaining ingredients. Bring 2 cups water to boil over medium-high heat. 2 Reduce heat and cover and simmer 15 minutes for flavors to blend. Pour 1/2 cup beans soup into blender puree until smooth and return to pot. Put other 1/2 cup bean in pot simmer soup uncovered 5 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.
